concerns.text: Coverage table re-labels FR-001 as 'download & preprocess ≥1 real dataset', but spec FR-001 mandates 'at least three public scRNA-seq datasets'. T003 does attempt all three accessions, so coverage exists in the task body, but the table silently weakens the requirement with no recorded spec amendment; correct the FR-001 row to match the spec text (or cite the plan Phase 0.3 case-study amendment).

The fidelity_results contract REQUIRES a `silhouette_threshold` column and sets `additionalProperties: false`, but T006's `fidelity_results.csv` columns are `embedding_id, method, dataset_id, ari, nmi, silhouette_score, optimal_resolution, runtime_seconds, peak_ram_gb` — no task produces the contract-required `silhouette_threshold` field, and the extra columns violate the closed schema. No task covers this contract element.

metrics_schema.schema.yaml requires fields `global_linearity` (Variance Explained Ratio) and `local_density` (Local PCA Reconstruction Error, k=30) with `additionalProperties: false`, but T009's `combined_metrics.parquet` uses `trustworthiness`/`local_continuity` column names and no task computes the schema's defined metrics. Either a task must produce a schema-conforming artifact or the contract must be amended; currently the contract has no covering task.

The dataset_schema.schema.yaml contract (JSON 2D integer counts array + cell_labels + gene_names) is an orphan: no task produces an artifact conforming to it (T003/T004 produce Parquet matrices, manifest JSON, label CSVs). Every active contract should have a producing task or be explicitly retired.

Constitution VI states the geometric diagnostics 'serve as the predictor variables for the study', but no task uses trustworthiness/local_continuity as model predictors — T007's model formula is `fidelity ~ method (+1|dataset)` and only 'merges' the geometric JSONs. The predictor-role element of the constitution has no covering task.
